conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Are there any specific techniques or practices people use to try and have lucid dreams?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Many people try "Mnemonic Induction of Lucid Dreams" (MILD), which involves setting an intention to recognize you're dreaming before falling asleep.
